scenes.heading: Create users in one request
scenes.sub: POST /v2/users replaces three calls with one.

before.label: Before
before.text: Three requests: create account, set profile, send invite.

after.label: With /v2/users
after.text: One request creates the user, profile and invite.

scenes.caption: One POST creates the user, profile and invite.

scenes.text: The old endpoints stay live for six months.
